purpose: Teach: 激戦/欠損/直観/天災/幻覚/無期/呪縛/避妊

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、近代の激戦地の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren — your paper focused on the fierce battlegrounds of the modern era, didn't it?
lines.style: Warm, observant tone. Gentle opening, like she's already read the paper and is giving him space to reflect on it himself. Steady pacing, no rush.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、人口減少による地域の欠損を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on regional depopulation and its consequences in my paper.
lines.style: Clear and measured. A slight pause at the start, gathering his thoughts. Speaking precisely because he's practiced this explanation before. Small earnestness underneath.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、直観に頼った判断の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren — so your research examined intuitive decision-making processes?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly puzzled tone—like she's testing whether his explanation matches what she saw in the paper. Gentle probe, not skeptical. Interested in the connection.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、天災に備える社会システムを論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote about social systems that prepare us for natural disasters.
lines.style: Steady, direct. He's correcting gently, not defensive. The clarity of someone who knows exactly what he studied. Quiet pride in the work underneath.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 幻覚症状を伴う精神疾患を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: So your paper addressed psychiatric conditions involving hallucinations?
lines.style: Engaged, checking in with genuine interest. A slight lean forward in her attention. Not confirming—genuinely interested in what he'll say next. Open and warm.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、無期懲役と仮釈放の判例研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I researched case law around life imprisonment and parole in my paper.
lines.style: Calm, matter-of-fact. He's pivoting clearly from what she assumed. No frustration, just setting the record straight. Speaks with the quiet authority of someone who knows his topic well.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、社会の呪縛から解放される運動を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren — your research covered movements for liberation from social constraints, then?
lines.style: Gentle, reflective. Another soft testing of assumptions. She's noticing a pattern now. Curious, not critical. The cadence of someone thinking aloud with a student she trusts.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、避妊普及の社会史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — my paper examined the social history of contraceptive access and adoption.
lines.style: Clear and calm closing. He's patient with her questioning by now. Speaking with quiet finality—the real subject matter at last. A small sense of relief that the truth is out.
